rules: Use only noun-verb semantic commands. Never use screen tap/tap-raw/tap-element or battle tick/advance.
A paused battle is continuous real time: plan while paused, then use run-until with state triggers; do not simulate turns.
The facility supplies evidence and calculations but never chooses for the contestant.
Only loaded-stage specifics may be queried; no future-node or future-stage spoilers.
Use no more than seven query commands before the first progress command.
